run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T06:33:13Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy reflects a ~2-minute burst of HTTP 500 responses for POST /api/checkout served by frontend-proxy: the first 500 appears at 06:33:31.787Z and the last at 06:35:33.401Z (frontend-proxy access log), matching the error-span burst seen in Prometheus span metrics (frontend-proxy ingress 94.4 errors/5m, router frontend egress 90/5m, frontend POST and executing api route /api/checkout 90/5m, checkout PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 52.8/5m at 06:37:14Z, back to ~0 by 06:41:14). The failing leg was checkout -> payment: the process log shows 500 - via_upstream (frontend answered 500), and checkout's own PaymentService/Charge client spans errored in exactly the same buckets while its other legs produced no error series. Root cause evidence: Deployment payment (namespace otel-demo) was rollout-restarted at 06:33:26Z - its two ReplicaSets carry identical container specs/image and differ only by the pod annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T06:33:26Z; the new ReplicaSet scaled 0->1, the old one 1->0, and the single old pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 was killed at 06:33:31Z, 0.8 s before the first 500. The replacement pod payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t had no readinessProbe, so it was reported Ready at 06:33:30 while its app logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' only at 06:34:47.791Z; successful 'payment went through' entries resume at 06:36:23Z and payment logged completed transactions at 06:43-06:44Z. The fault-injection flags currently in ConfigMap flagd-config (paymentFailure defaultVariant 100%, paymentUnreachable on) do not match the observed failure path and are reported as an unresolved hypothesis, not as the cause.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own access log shows POST /api/checkout returning HTTP 500 from 2026-11-17T06:33:31.787536Z (earliest of 42 such lines in 06:33:00-06:34:31Z) through 2026-11-17T06:35:33.401153Z (last of 6 such lines in 06:35:20-06:40:00Z); all carry '500 - via_upstream', i.e. the upstream (frontend) answered 500, not the proxy failing itself.

Before the burst, the only 5xx found in frontend-proxy's access log for 06:10:00-06:31:54Z was a single 503 on GET /api/cart at 06:12:36.849269Z ('upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}'); the read reached 06:31:54Z before the 4 MiB limit.

Error-status span series (traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}) rose from 0 only for the checkout path: at 06:35:14Z frontend POST /api/checkout=45.56, frontend executing api route (pages) /api/checkout=45.56, frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder=45.56, checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder=52.78, checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge=52.78; peak at 06:37:14Z frontend legs=90, checkout legs=50-52.78, frontend-proxy ingress=94.44 and router frontend egress=90; back to 1.11 or 0 from 06:41:14Z onward.

Whole-window error-span increases attribute the burst to the checkout/payment path: frontend-proxy ingress STATUS_CODE_ERROR=96.64, router frontend egress=82.40, frontend POST /api/checkout=82.40, frontend executing api route (pages) /api/checkout=82.40, frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder=82.40, checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder=42.11 and checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge=42.11; other frontend routes (GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, GET /api/data) show 0 error spans.

Kubernetes events for Deployment payment in otel-demo show a rollout at 06:33:26-06:33:31Z: ScalingReplicaSet 'Scaled up replica set payment-79d86bf97f from 0 to 1', ReplicaSet payment-79d86bf97f SuccessfulCreate at 06:33:26Z, and at 06:33:31Z Pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 'Stopping container payment' (Killing) plus ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 SuccessfulDelete 'Deleted pod: payment-55766d76b9-5frt4', and Deployment payment 'Scaled down replica set payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0'.

The two payment ReplicaSets have identical pod templates - same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, same env (PAYMENT_PORT, FLAGD_HOST=flagd, FLAGD_PORT=8013, OTEL_*), same resources and no readiness/liveness probe - and differ only in the pod annotation: payment-79d86bf97f carries kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T06:33:26Z, payment-55766d76b9 does not; payment-55766d76b9 was created 06:01:31Z (revision 1, replicas 0) and payment-79d86bf97f at 06:33:26Z (revision 2, replicas 1).

Replacement pod payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t was created 06:33:26Z, its payment container started 06:33:30Z, restart count 0, no readinessProbe defined (probes null) and all pod conditions Ready=True; its application logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' only at 06:34:47.791Z - about 77 s after the container started.
The new payment pod also logged '14 UNAVAILABLE: Connection dropped' at 06:35:43.851Z, i.e. during/just after the failing interval.

Checkout recovered: checkout logged 'payment went through' as early as 06:36:23.698Z-06:36:27.192Z (32 such lines within 06:35:20-06:36:30Z) and again at 06:37:53.69Z; payment's own log shows 'Charge request received.' / 'Transaction complete.' pairs at 06:43:56-06:44:22Z.

Among otel-demo application Deployments, only payment produced a new ReplicaSet during the incident window (payment-79d86bf97f revision 2 at 06:33:26Z); every other application ReplicaSet is revision 1 created at 06:01:30-06:01:32Z, and flagd's revision 2 dates from 06:03:16Z, before the incident.

The payment Deployment is Helm-managed (meta.helm.sh/release-name=otel-demo) at revision 2; its container spec (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, env PAYMENT_PORT/FLAGD_HOST/FLAGD_PORT/OTEL_*, limits cpu 20m/memory 160Mi) contains no fault-injection settings.

Payment's replacement pod shows 0 restarts and no OOMKilled/Evicted marking, and the old pod was removed by its own ReplicaSet ('SuccessfulDelete', 'Killing', 'Stopping container payment'), so the outage was a controller-driven pod replacement, not a crash, OOM or eviction.

The fault-injection settings in ConfigMap flagd-config (paymentFailure defaultVariant '100%' and paymentUnreachable defaultVariant 'on', both ENABLED) are still present at read time (06:56Z) while checkout logged 'payment went through' from 06:36:23Z and payment logged completed transactions at 06:43-06:44Z, so these settings alone do not explain the bounded charge-failure burst.

Continuous low-rate flagd EventStream errors on ad (up to 1.25/5m) and fraud-detection/recommendation (1.11/5m) appear in every 5-minute bucket from 03:56Z through 06:56Z, i.e. before, during and after the alert, and never involve the checkout/payment path - they are background, not this incident.

Rejected: a crash-loop or resource kill of payment. The replacement container has restartCount 0 with no lastState.terminated reason, the only otel-demo events in the window are the payment rollout's Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started/Killing/SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete and two ScalingReplicaSet events, and no Evicted/OOMKilled marker exists.

The 06:33:26Z kubectl rollout restart of Deployment payment was the trigger that made the failure reach users: with a single replica, no readinessProbe and a ~77 s gap between container start and gRPC server listen, terminating the old pod at 06:33:31Z left no payment backend, so checkout's PlaceOrder/Charge calls errored and frontend returned 500s on /api/checkout until the new server was serving (~06:35:33-06:36:23Z). What/who issued that restart is not established.

The paymentFailure='100%' and paymentUnreachable='on' fault-injection flags in ConfigMap flagd-config may be connected to why payment was restarted at 06:33:26Z (payment consumes FLAGD_HOST=flagd/FLAGD_PORT=8013), but this remains unverified: flagd's pod produced no log lines in 06:20-06:45Z and no ConfigMap history is available, and the observed failure was a bounded serving gap rather than the persistent flag-declared failure mode.

Add a readinessProbe (gRPC/TCP 8080) to Deployment payment, raise its replica count above one and set the rolling-update maxUnavailable to 0, so that a restart cannot retire the only serving payment backend while the replacement is still starting.

Review why Deployment payment was rollout-restarted at 2026-11-17T06:33:26Z (change history is not integrated in this run) and confirm the intended state of the flagd fault flags paymentFailure and paymentUnreachable, which currently read '100%' and 'on'; if injection was not intended, they should be returned to 'off'.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available, so the actor/tooling and stated reason behind the kubectl rollout restart of Deployment payment at 2026-11-17T06:33:26Z (kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T06:33:26Z) could not be verified.

kube_pod_container_info returned no series for namespace otel-demo, so the old and new payment pods' image digests (image_id) could not be compared; the two ReplicaSets' pod templates specify the same image tag ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment and identical container specs apart from restartedAt.

Jaeger returned traces only up to 2026-11-17T06:24:56Z (data_as_of 06:24:56), so no trace-level evidence exists for the 06:33-06:36Z incident window; the error attribution rests on Prometheus span metrics and container logs.
The flagd pod produced no readable log lines in 06:20-06:45Z and ConfigMap history is not available, so when paymentFailure/paymentUnreachable were set to their current values cannot be determined.
The old payment pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 was deleted, so its logs (including any startup/termination reason) could not be read.
The frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-f44st returned no log lines for 06:30-06:42Z, so the frontend-side error text for the failed /api/checkout calls is unknown.
list_prometheus_rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no data, so the alert's exact expression, threshold and evaluation window could not be confirmed from this Prometheus.

The frontend-proxy access-log scan for pre-incident 5xx stopped at the 4 MiB read limit at 06:31:54Z; the 06:31:54-06:33:00Z interval was not read (the 06:33:00-06:34:31Z query showed the first 5xx at 06:33:31.787Z).
next_steps: Check the cluster's change/audit history for a kubectl rollout restart or Helm/kubectl action against Deployment payment in namespace otel-demo at 2026-11-17T06:33:26Z.
Verify with the flagd configuration owner whether paymentFailure=100% and paymentUnreachable=on are intended, and compare against the values in effect at 06:30-06:40Z.
Inspect the payment application's startup path (why its gRPC server listened ~77 s after container start) and add a readinessProbe plus more than one replica before the next rollout.

Confirm whether any other alert instance fired for this burst and whether the RequestErrorRate rule (not loaded in this Prometheus) is intentionally 'above 0', which makes it sensitive to single-request blips such as the 06:12:36Z 503.
